title: [Extensibility Request] issue 30379: enable grouped pick printing
summary: Report 5754 now exposes pick headers before printing through an event, allowing extensions to implement grouped printing while preserving the default behavior.
key_points: Extracted standard pick-header enumeration and printing into a new event handler flow
Extensions can subscribe to print all picks in one consolidated report run
Existing default behavior remains unchanged for users without extensions
Event is marked with IsHandled flag to allow complete replacement of print flow
Addresses extensibility request to support batch printing of warehouse picks
quote: Extensions need to print all picks generated by Report 5754 in one consolidated report run
